decision: PM assignment f11ea60e. Independent TL review 7854ccfc of product revision 3011abe02c1650ef4451cf784b4c6b6f6065d920. CI administrator precheck de5ef8a1 assigned the inputs to these receipts.
purpose: Validate production key configuration at the API entry point and preserve explicit test and development behavior.
data: Synthetic CLI environments, published fixture values and freshly generated keys. Twelve serial child processes across four cases stop before database access.
concurrency: One child process at a time per test file. Existing functional workers and jobs.
repetitions: One execution per case in the existing server functional suite, with a 10-second timeout per child.
thresholds: Rejected key material stops startup with the setting name and generation instructions and is absent from diagnostics. Fresh keys and explicit nonproduction fixtures reach the subsequent configuration check.
trigger: Existing server functional test discovery for PR and main.
cost: Four case bodies took about one second in local verification. Estimated additional CI runtime is a few seconds on an existing worker.

cases: production rejects published or constant JWT secrets and names only the setting
all four bank rings reject published material under any key ID including inactive versions
a repeated-byte bank fixture and a published bank key reused as JWT are rejected
fresh production keys and explicit nonproduction fixtures reach application configuration
